text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdosage of clarithromycin tablets can cause gastrointestinal symptoms such as abdominal pain, vomiting, nausea, and diarrhea. Treat adverse reactions accompanying overdosage by the prompt elimination of unabsorbed drug and supportive measures. As with other macrolides, clarithromycin tablets serum concentrations are not expected to be appreciably affected by hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis.
